plan.question: At seed 42, half-minus-full validation AUC is +0.0001204973277 for aligned products and +0.0004667050401 for crossed products, giving a crossed-minus-aligned interaction of +0.0003462077124. Aligned half nevertheless worsens both AUC and Logloss for empty and 1-16-event histories relative to aligned full. Do these population effects, interaction and exploratory sparse-history regressions persist under prospectively paired seeds 43/44 in one verified implementation family? Retrieve the original factorial and latest closure records to define a fixed comparison against the original target-aware baseline, subject to an authorized seed interface and complete repetition/assessment reserves. Round32 transport candidate/reference have identical reported quality and only a single sub-percent training-time contrast, so they supply neither independent-seed robustness nor a reason for further timing-only retraining. This is a replication/attribution question about an inherited mechanism; it does not establish semantic mediation or novelty. No experiment or withheld assessment is requested in this query phase.
missing_information: An authorized later-phase interface for paired seeds 43/44. The frozen research train_seed is 42; final_paired_seeds does not itself authorize a research seed override. No seed override or training is permitted now.

Accessible source/configuration/checkpoint identities and parameter-construction, optimizer and checkpoint-selection rules for the baseline and all four factorial cells. Current workspace exports no model files or ancestor sources. Reuse seed42 artifacts only after matching data, protocol, source, configuration and checkpoint identities; do not silently combine round32 transport with earlier factorial sources.

The authoritative remaining resource ledger and full preparation, diagnostics, failed-attempt, repetition and closed-assessment tariffs. The runtime snapshot is about 28092 seconds; ten additional baseline-plus-factorial jobs at seeds43/44 estimate 7044 seconds, or 17609 seconds at summed trial caps, before other costs. If seed42 artifacts cannot be reused, fifteen jobs estimate 10566 seconds or 26414 seconds at summed caps. These are conditional arithmetic, not admitted jobs or verified reserves. Narrow the suite and relinquish interaction claims if a complete funded factorial is unavailable.

Authorized validation prediction vectors and user-cluster identities for paired uncertainty estimates; current aggregate receipts cannot estimate paired user-cluster intervals. New seeds would not remove adaptive validation-selection bias.

Prospectively fixed subgroup reporting and counts across seeds, retaining existing history bins and their exploratory origin. Empty history has 8272 impressions/310 positives and history1_16 has 41805/1444; overlap and shared-parameter effects preclude a causal sparse-history explanation from these summaries alone.

Later-phase suite-freeze and closed-assessment interfaces, commands, source/configuration/checkpoint hashes and costs. Selection and comparisons must be frozen using validation before one closed phase; withheld outcomes must remain outside open research memory. If required interfaces or complete resources remain unavailable, document the access limitation and conclude with preliminary single-seed findings rather than substitute seed42 replays.
